author: antraxia
text:
Finally starting my homework, its long overdue.

Don't want to get too crazy with marking all the stuff on the chart so I've only marked what I think are the important ones and noted the reaction with FTB. There are many new FTRs generated upon reaction to the original zones but I'm trying to keep the chart clean and rather than just mark out 200 of these guys I want to try and get 200 important ones.

1)RBD (from the 5M) and small FO which causes a QM level and reacts to the pip on return ( not shown). 2) DBD DP to break into the compression to the left reacts on return. 3) RBD FTR from entrance into compression on the left reacts FTB. 4) DBD formed in the middle of compression to the left not surprising, it gets faked on return (compression is a PAZ so we are interested in the edges of the zone). It ends up being a flip zone. 5) DBR current cap on price strengthened by the engulf of 4. Price reacts on return. 6) DBR 15M base of move up. Price compresses into base forming a nice QM and we are also in H4 demand. 7) this DBR is a point of interest as its the last tiny pocket of demand left before entering the new CP zone. It reacts on FTB (DBD on 5M) is engulfed and then produces a FTR from the other side proving it still holds relevance as a zone on our chart (the boxes are drawn approximately on the 15M). #8 is a very important RBD as it is the top of compression so once engulfed it makes the DBR at 9) worthy of a trade even though it has been tested as we are coming from HTF supply and we have broken into a new zone and will test higher maybe even continue on up to the next H4 supply.
